name: short-02-same-skill
notes: BATCH-01 script #3. PSYCH pillar. Hook: contradiction. The thesis post - pin this one.

scenes.text: Cold calling and going viral are the same skill.
scenes.vo: Cold calling and going viral are the same skill. Nobody says this.

scenes.text: Both are a stranger deciding whether to keep paying attention.
scenes.vo: Both are a stranger deciding whether to keep paying attention.

scenes.label: SECONDS ON A CALL
scenes.vo: On a call, you get about eight seconds.

scenes.label: SECONDS ON A FEED
scenes.vo: On a feed, you get three.

scenes.text: Both die from the exact same thing.
scenes.vo: Both die from the exact same thing.

scenes.text: "Hey, how's your day going?" is the same mistake as "hey guys, welcome back."
scenes.vo: Hey, how's your day going, is the same mistake as, hey guys welcome back.

scenes.label: THE FIX
scenes.text: Open mid-motion. No throat-clearing, no permission, no warm-up. Start where it's already interesting.
scenes.vo: The fix is the same too. Open mid motion. No throat clearing, no permission, no warm up. Start where it's already interesting.

scenes.text: Every good opener is a cold open.
scenes.vo: Every good opener is a cold open.
